Title: Azure Log Analytics saved searches functionality is moving to query explorer

Body.Content:
Azure Log Analytics saved searches functionality is now available in query explorer, which allows you to use and manage your saved queries.

All of your saved searches are available in query explorer. To manage them, browse to Logs from your Azure Monitor Log Analytics workspace or your Application Insights component, and choose Query explorer from the top actions menu:

There are no changes to the API to manage queries.

We appreciate your feedback. If you have questions or suggestions, please email us.
